content.text:
All tests pass. Here's the diagnosis and fix:

## Root Cause

In `crates/liwe/src/markdown.rs`, `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` was filtering out YAML continuation lines (lines starting with a space, like `  - foo`) from the frontmatter header before wrapping it in `---` fences:

```rust
.filter(|l| !l.starts_with(' '))
```

This meant a bare frontmatter block like:

```
title: Task A
depends:
  - foo
  - bar
```

got wrapped as:

```
---
title: Task A
depends:
---
```

The sequence items (`  - foo`, `  - bar`) were stripped, so `depends` parsed as `null` instead of `["foo", "bar"]`. Fenced frontmatter (`---` delimited) bypassed `wrap_bare_frontmatter()` entirely, so it worked fine.

## Fix

Removed the `cleaned_header` filtering — the full header block (including indented continuation lines) is now passed through to the `---` fences intact. The filter was 6 lines duplicated across two branches; both branches and the duplication were eliminated.

## Test Added

`bare_frontmatter_sequence_value_matches` in `crates/liwe/tests/find_metadata_test.rs` — verifies that `--meta depends=foo` matches a bare-frontmatter document with `depends: [foo, bar]`.
